fusions.name: Reef-Toothed Edge
fusions.desc: A jagged chop that deals 4 damage and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Colony Spread
fusions.desc: Sweeps the axe around you, dealing 11 water damage to every enemy within 3 tiles. Your afflictions on each one spread to every enemy within 4 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Barnacled Haft
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 50% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it, and leaves them [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Calcified Layers
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once: you gain a shield that absorbs 5% of your maximum health per stack, 25% at full. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
